origin_instruction: Stand just inside the main entrance, facing the corridor of display cases. Point the camera straight ahead.
origin_retry: I only know the saved route from the main entrance to the lifts. Please face the corridor of display cases again.

origin.description: Corridor lined with glass display cases, with RMIT University glass doors at the far end
required_features: Corridor lined on both sides with glass display cases holding garments
Glass doors with red RMIT University logos at the far end of the corridor

checkpoints.description: Row of waist-high stainless-steel ticket gates in front of a grey tiled wall
required_features: Row of waist-high stainless-steel ticket gates
Grey tiled wall with a wall-mounted TV screen behind the gates

hazards.action: Keep going straight. It opens by itself.
features: Glass doors across the corridor with red RMIT University logos

checkpoints.description: Stainless-steel lift doors beside an IN CASE OF FIRE DO NOT USE ELEVATOR sign
required_features: Stainless-steel lift doors set in a grey tiled wall

arrival: You have arrived at the lifts. The call button is on your right. Take the lift up to level 3. Route finished. Camera stopped.
